name: Trantor Ice Mine
summary: Water from buried glacial ice. Hot water is pumped down Rodriguez wells, melts a pool in the ice, and the melt is pumped back up to treatment, where perchlorate is removed.
since_note: Trantor, begun in 2155, was finished in 2159.
story: Hellas is rich in minerals, and its water far exceeds other low-latitude regions. The mining company Ava Mars grew its outpost into a base and proposed the open Trantor City plan, built from 2155.
process: Hot-water supply at 85 degC from reactor waste heat
Rodriguez well: 30 m3/h of hot water melts about 21 m3/h of ice (334 kJ/kg latent heat plus warming from -55 degC)
Melt pool level control and production pumps; the heater string is lowered every 120 days
Perchlorate in the raw melt, measured by the lab

sources.label: Lunardini and Rand 1995, Thermal design of an Antarctic water well (CRREL Special Report 95-10)
Holt et al. 2008, Radar evidence for ice in lobate debris aprons near Hellas, Science 322
Hecht et al. 2009, Perchlorate at the Phoenix landing site, Science 325
